summary: The Copilot acceptance kit gains hook.sh/hook.py (the review session under vloop fence hook asked for each worked-example deny form and a non-vloop skill, plus the hook missing, exit 1, not JSON and timing out) and second.sh (a feedback-mode run with a copilot second reviewer, reported by report.py second); the README documents each part.
verified: vloop task gate T8 exited 0 and printed gate T8: ok.
notes: Not run against real Copilot (no network). hook.py edits the hooks file vloop wrote in the logged review session's COPILOT_HOME (shape from internal/driver/agent_copilot.go, unconfirmed against Copilot docs) and parses tool.execution_start/complete events (data.toolCallId, data.arguments, error.code denied) as written in copilot-cli-experiments.md; the start event's field names are unverified. hook.sh needs run.sh first (reuses its argv log and shims).
